message: There was a login disruption arising from one-time password (OTP) on 2026-11-13 09:00.  The system had resumed normal operations on 2026-11-13 21:45.  We sincerely apologise for the inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.  我們的系統登入一次密碼（OTP）發送曾於香港時間 2026-11-13 09:00 出現暫時中斷，系統的服務已於 2026-11-13 21:45 回復正常。我們對是次事故造成的不便深表歉意，並感謝您的體諒。
